CHAPTER 7 · ITEM 02 / 10

Consumer and producer surplus

Costs and PS成本與生產者剩餘

YOUR CHECKBOX · 原始清單項目

Interpret sellers' opportunity costs, the supply curve and the marginal seller. Compute producer surplus as the price received minus cost, summed over units sold.

01 · UNDERSTAND / 概念解釋

賣方成本是供應單位的機會成本。PS 是售出單位的價格減成本總和；供給線顯示邊際成本。存在固定成本時，PS 通常等於利潤加固定成本。

A seller's cost measures the opportunity cost of supplying a unit. Producer surplus sums price−cost over units sold; supply gives the marginal seller's cost. With fixed costs, PS generally differs from profit by fixed cost.

02 · WORKED EXAMPLE / 一個示範

See it in action.

Example 例：Unit costs 1,3,5 and P=4. Sell two; PS=(4−1)+(4−3)=4.

03 · TRY IT / 例題練習

One question. Your turn.

Unit costs 2,4,7 and P=6. PS? 成本二、四、七，價格六？
